value.rationale: The double of a simplicial complex is a motivated recent construction; boundaries of cross-polytopes are canonical symmetric flag spheres. An exact first-occurrence of integral 3-torsion together with its full signed-coordinate character identifies a naturally occurring integral symmetry obstruction, and distinguishes an involution quotient from the unquotiented complex over F3. The relevant torsion character is neither a Betti number nor a mere parameter substitution in the inflation formula.
